## Loading Packages
```{r load-packages, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(scales)
```

## Global Themes 
```{r global-theme, message=FALSE}
viz_theme <- theme_classic() + 
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", family = "serif"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", family = "serif"),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12, family = "serif"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", family = "serif"))

```

## Importing Data
```{r data, message=FALSE}
# Subset data
es <- read.csv("data/es_ma.csv")
```

# Analysis

## View Coded items

```{r es-codes}
table(es$stat_info)

# look at other code explanations
es_other <- es %>%
  filter(stat_info == "Other")

es_other
# all are not specific to the reference

es_yes <- es %>%
  filter(stat_info == "Yes") %>%
  filter(unique_id != "U10645") %>% # mistakenly coded as Yes
  filter(unique_id != "U10431") %>% # mistakenly coded as Yes
  select(ma_id, label, unique_id, id, stat_info, stat_explain, es_value, average_es)

table(es_yes$stat_info) # confirm only yes
```

## Expanding into columns of effect sizes

```{r reported-es-split}
es_split <- es_yes %>%
  mutate(nums = str_extract_all(stat_explain, "-?(?:\\d+\\.\\d+|\\.\\d+)")) %>%
  mutate(nums = lapply(nums, \(x) gsub("^\\.", "0.", x))) %>% # add 0 in front
  mutate(nums = lapply(nums, \(x) gsub("^\\-\\.", "-0.", x))) %>% # add 0 in front
  unnest_wider(nums, names_sep = "_") %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("nums_"), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("nums_"), ~ format(round(.x, 2), nsmall = 2)))
```

## Compare to MA Average

```{r es-compare}
es_split <- es_split %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("nums_"), as.numeric)) %>%   
  mutate(match_avg = if_any(
    starts_with("nums_"),
    ~ replace(.x == average_es, is.na(.x), FALSE)))

table(es_split$match_avg)
```

## Look at those that don't match
```{r no-match}
es_no_match <- es_split %>%
  filter(match_avg == FALSE) 

view(es_no_match)
```

All of those (except U10850 and U10849) do not report the average effect, only subgroups. U10234 reports a percentage point increase which isn't in the MA but is in a summary report of the research from the authors. U10850 and U10849 report an effect size but i am not sure what it is. It is a blog though and i wouldn't trust them.  

```{r es-by-ma}
ggplot(es_split, aes(x = ma_id, fill = match_avg)) +
  geom_bar() +
  geom_text(stat = 'count', aes(label = after_stat(count)), 
            position = position_stack(), 
            vjust = 2, size = 3, colour = "black")
```

```{r avg-or-other-es}
es_type <- es_split %>%
  mutate(avg_es_yes = case_when(
    match_avg == TRUE & (is.na(nums_2) | nums_2 == "") ~ "Average ES Only",
    match_avg == TRUE & (!is.na(nums_2) & nums_2 != "") ~ "Average ES + Other ES",
    match_avg == FALSE ~ "Other ES")) %>% 
  mutate(avg_es_yes = ifelse(unique_id %in% c("U10234", "U10849", "U10850"), 
                             "Unclear", avg_es_yes))

table(es_type$avg_es_yes)

type_es <- ggplot(es_type, aes(avg_es_yes)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#9dc892") +
  geom_text(stat = "count", aes(label = ..count..), vjust = -0.5, 
            family = "serif", size = 4) +
  labs(x = "Effect Sizes Reported", y = "Number of Documents") +
  viz_theme

type_es

# save image
# ggsave("visuals/es_reported.png", type_es, device = "png", height = 5, width = 7)
```
